The National Centre for Gynaecological Cancers (NCGC) within Cancer Australia invites innovative and cost effective proposals from interested parties who have a demonstrated track record of high quality research experience relevant to clinical guidelines development, and project management skills. The objective is to develop succinct, print-ready, evidence-based, clinical practice guidance material for specialists in relation to three priority areas:

  1. Psychosocial, psychosexual, and supportive care needs of women with endometrial cancer including how best to deliver the treatment.
  2. Treatment options for women with recurrent or locally advanced endometrial cancer including how best to deliver the treatment.
  3. Treatment for abnormal vaginal bleeding in pre?menopausal and post-menopausal women, including identification of ideal investigations and referral to optimise outcomes.
Tenderers may choose to undertake one, two or all three priority areas. The guidance material is intended to build the capacity of Australia’s health workforce and professionals in gynaecological cancers, through an increased understanding of best practice and care.
